concepts.body: Active view Notes. Artwork style is crisp abstract geometry. Across the off-white canvas float large translucent colored circles, precise rings, vertical dashes and long curves with balanced negative space. Red, orange, yellow, green, cyan, blue, violet, magenta all represented as distinct note groups rather than random rainbow decoration. Three big overlapping rings near center-right are RED, GREEN, ORANGE and have small adjacent labels 'C', 'E', 'G'. A few lower opacity earlier note marks trail off leftwards, forming a readable melody. A compact legend below artwork says 'Each note has a color' and shows 12 distinct small color swatches with their note names C C♯ D D♯ E F F♯ G G♯ A A♯ B. Small top-right style selector reads 'Style: Shapes'. The mapping is example-only.

No sidebar, no marketing hero, no statistics, no neon dark background, no card grid. The image must demonstrate the specific trigger with legible supporting labels. concepts.body: Active view Pitch. Artwork style is flowing sound waves. A beautiful large field of smooth horizontal oscillating ribbons crossing the canvas from left to right: deep indigo and dark violet broad slow low-frequency waves in lower third, richly colored turquoise flowing waves in middle, airy golden and pale pink fine high-frequency wisps upper third. This is visually coherent flowing wave geometry, not stock equalizer bars. Discreet vertical labels at far left of art read 'High', 'Mid', 'Low'. Three small words below art read 'Higher pitch → lighter color'. Small top-right style selector reads 'Style: Sound waves'. Beautiful balanced wave composition, clearly pitch changes both position and brightness. Tiny bottom legend 'Illustrative pitch mapping'.

concepts.body: Active view Instruments. Artwork style Ink in water, physically beautiful cyan/cobalt/violet reference-inspired opaque ink plumes suspended in white water, with soft billowing cauliflower folds, translucent edges, realistic studio backlighting and volume. Four distinct but partially overlapping pigment clouds across most of screen: piano electric cyan on left and center-low, strings deep violet curled across upper-middle and right, vocals rich fuchsia at center, drums golden-orange pulses lower-right. Clear small annotation pills near the cloud groups read 'Piano', 'Strings', 'Vocals', 'Drums', each with matching colored dot and fine unobtrusive leader. A compact legend below says 'One color per instrument · example palette'. Small top-right style selector reads 'Style: Ink in water'. Colored masses fill most of art area while white shows around intricate folds. No images of actual instruments, no musical notes printed in the plumes.

concepts.body: Active view Harmony. Artwork style Crystal. A spectacular broad formation of translucent cut-glass faceted forms floats against clean white, with luminous but physically shaded green, teal and golden-orange faceted cores corresponding to three different chords; subtle pale colored light pools below. Not a single rainbow gem. A dominant cluster of three interlocking angular crystals center-left combines red, green and orange reflections in one coherent object and has a small annotation 'C major · C E G'. A smaller farther violet and teal cluster right says 'A minor · A C E'. Ghosted pale outlines in background suggest earlier chords transitioning. Bottom caption 'Chords shape the palette · example colors'. Small top-right style selector reads 'Style: Crystal'. Polished editorial art composition with dimensional refraction, no grid, no giant glowing blobs.

concepts.body: Active view Whole Song. Artwork style Watercolor. A richly detailed wide panoramic watercolor painting across most of viewport tells the changing journey of one song left-to-right: quiet pale blue washes at left, layered turquoise and vivid green pigment flowing into ochre and coral full central bloom, then violet plum and deep cobalt fluid abstract strokes toward right, resolving in light pink translucent veils. Genuine layered watercolour on warm white paper, delicate granulation and pooled pigment edges, organic transitions and room to breathe without a blank half-screen. A thin timeline at bottom of art aligns three small section labels 'Intro', 'Build', 'Chorus'. Small caption 'A color journey across the song · illustrative analysis'. Small top-right style selector reads 'Style: Watercolor'. No literal landscapes, no mountains, no physical brushes, no photos of paper.
